title: Bootstrap Spring Boot 4.1.1
scope: Base app, health, Flyway V1, H2, CORS for Vite. Already on main.
implementation_notes: Do not re-scaffold. Later tasks branch from main (or previous merged branch).
test_plan: `./mvnw test` includes HealthControllerTest and contextLoads.

title: Local MariaDB via Docker Compose
scope: Add compose + application-local profile using MariaDB; keep H2 as default test.
implementation_notes: docker-compose.yml: MariaDB 11, db printmomentum, healthcheck. application-local.properties datasource + flyway. Document JAVA_HOME 21. Do not change test profile.
test_plan: `docker compose up -d` then `./mvnw spring-boot:run -Dspring-boot.run.profiles=local` starts. `./mvnw test` still uses H2 and passes.

title: Flyway schema for listings and shops
scope: V2 SQL: shop, listing, listing_image. MySQL-compatible for H2 MODE=MySQL and MariaDB.
implementation_notes: Tables: shop(shop_id PK, name, url), listing(listing_id PK, shop_id FK, title, description, url, taxonomy_id, price_amount, currency, tags JSON/text, num_favorers, etsy_created_at, etsy_updated_at, print_tee_score, is_print_tee, first_seen_at, last_seen_at), listing_image(id, listing_id, url, rank). Indexes on is_print_tee, last_seen_at.
test_plan: `./mvnw test` Flyway migrates on H2. Add a test that jdbcTemplate counts tables or uses FlywayMigrationTest. Insert one listing in test.
done_when: Migration applies on H2 and local MariaDB.

title: JPA entities and repositories
scope: Map V2 tables. No JSON leak of entities.
implementation_notes: Records/entities in domain/. Repositories: ListingRepository, ShopRepository. ddl-auto=validate must pass against Flyway.
test_plan: @DataJpaTest or @SpringBootTest saving a listing with shop. Unique listing_id enforced.

title: Etsy Open API v3 RestClient
scope: Typed client, timeouts, 429 retry, quota headers. No live calls in tests.
implementation_notes: Read skill etsy-openapi-v3. RestClient bean, EtsyProperties from ETSY_API_KEY. Methods: searchActive, getListing, getTaxonomy. Map only documented fields. Throw EtsyUnavailableException on 5xx/429 exhausted.
test_plan: WireMock or MockRestServiceServer: 200 maps listing_id/title/num_favorers; 429 retries then fails; missing API key fails fast at startup only if etsy profile. Unit test JSON mapping fixture.
done_when: Client covers search+getListing; CI never hits Etsy.

title: Printable t-shirt classifier
scope: Score 0-1 + is_print_tee at 0.7 + reject reasons.
implementation_notes: Read printmomentum-domain skill. Pure Java service, no Spring if possible. Include print/graphic/DTG; exclude vintage, used, embroidery, blank wholesale, hoodie. Configurable keyword lists in yaml.
test_plan: Golden fixture JSON of 15 titles/tags (8 include, 7 exclude). Assert threshold. No network.
done_when: Precision on fixtures documented; unit tests pass.

title: Ingest job upserts listings
scope: Scheduled job searches Etsy keywords/taxonomy, classifies, upserts.
implementation_notes: @Scheduled or Spring Batch lite. Query set in yaml (graphic tee, printed t-shirt, etc.). Idempotent upsert by listing_id. Skip non-print unless score stored. Capture crawl_run_id. Disable schedule in tests with property.
test_plan: @SpringBootTest with stub EtsyClient returning 3 listings; one excluded. Assert 2 print tees stored, 1 stored with is_print_tee=false or skipped per spec (pick skip). Second run does not duplicate.
done_when: Job is idempotent; schedule off in test.

title: Append-only rank snapshots
scope: Each crawl stores position + favorers + reviews proxy.
implementation_notes: Table listing_snapshot(id, listing_id, crawl_run_id, observed_at, position, num_favorers). Never update old rows. Set first_seen_in_top_at when position <= N (N=100 default).
test_plan: Test: two crawls, positions 5 then 40; two snapshot rows; first_seen_in_top_at set once.

title: Momentum ranking formula
scope: days_to_top + recency + favorers delta.
implementation_notes: Read domain skill. ListingRanker computes score. 2-day climb beats 30-day occupant. Formula in one class with comments. Persist last_score + last_scored_at.
test_plan: Unit tests: (created 10d ago, top in 2d) > (created 400d ago, in top 30d). Tie-breaker: larger favorers delta. Zero-division guarded.

title: GET /api/v1/listings ranked feed
scope: Paginated feed of print tees by momentum.
implementation_notes: Query params: page,size,maxDaysToTop,minScore,q. Response DTO: listingId,title,price,currency,imageUrl,etsyUrl,daysToTop,momentumScore,numFavorers,shopName. Default isPrintTee=true. Jackson camelCase.
test_plan: @WebMvcTest or MockMvc: empty 200 items[]; fixture 2 listings ordered by score desc; size=1 returns 1; invalid size=1000 -> 400.
done_when: Contract tests pass; no entities in JSON.

title: GET /api/v1/listings/{id}
scope: Detail + last K snapshots for sparkline.
implementation_notes: 404 if missing. Include rejectReasons only if debug=true (default false).
test_plan: 404 test; 200 includes snapshots newest last.
done_when: Detail matches feed fields plus snapshots.

title: RFC 7807 errors
scope: Global handler for validation, not found, etsy down.
implementation_notes: application/problem+json; no stack traces to client.
test_plan: Mvc tests: 400, 404, stub 503 for etsy.

title: Cache listing images on S3
scope: Download Etsy image once, store S3 key, serve CloudFront or signed URL later.
implementation_notes: AWS SDK v2. Local profile no-op (keep Etsy URL). Never commit credentials.
test_plan: Test with S3 mock (Localstack optional) or interface FakeObjectStorage. Assert key format listings/{id}/{n}.jpg.
done_when: Storage port + local fake; optional Localstack IT tagged.

title: Etsy quota metrics and ingest guard
scope: Micrometer gauges for remaining QPD; skip crawl if remaining < threshold.
implementation_notes: Actuator metrics. Log remaining-today. Alert later.
test_plan: Unit test: remaining 5 -> job skip; remaining 5000 -> run.

title: Cache t-shirt taxonomy ids
scope: Resolve clothing > t-shirts ids, 24h cache.
implementation_notes: Caffeine or Spring Cache. Fallback to yaml ids if Etsy fails.
test_plan: Test cache hit (client called once for two lookups).

title: Protect API with API keys (MVP SaaS)
scope: Header X-Api-Key. Public: health.
implementation_notes: Table api_client. 401 on missing/invalid. Dev default key in local profile only.
test_plan: Mvc: health 200 no key; listings 401; valid key 200.
